description: The chart is a 100% stacked bar chart illustrating the distribution of “Targets” categories across years from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable “Year,” labeled “Year,” with years shown in ascending order (2012, 2013, …, 2022). The vertical axis is a proportion scale running from 0.0 to 1.0 (linear), with tick marks at regular 0.2 intervals, and each stacked bar reaches a total height of 1.0. A legend titled “Targets” maps colors to categories: blue = “0,” orange = “1,” green = “2–4,” red = “5–7,” and purple = “8+.” For 2012, the bar is entirely green (2–4) at 1.0; for 2013, the bar is entirely blue (0) at 1.0. In 2014 and 2015, bars are split between blue (0) and orange (1) and/or green (2–4), with 2014 appearing roughly half blue and half orange, and 2015 roughly half blue and half green. In 2016, the bar shows three segments with blue around 0.25, orange around 0.50, and green around 0.25. In 2017, the bar includes blue around 0.50, orange around 0.20, green around 0.25, and a small red segment near the top (about 0.05). In 2018, the bar includes blue around 0.40, orange around 0.25, green around 0.20, and red around 0.15. In 2019, the bar includes blue around 0.20, orange around 0.20, green around 0.20, a larger red segment around 0.35, and a small purple segment around 0.05. In 2020, the bar includes blue around 0.35, orange around 0.25, green around 0.25, red around 0.10, and purple around 0.05. In 2021, the bar includes blue around 0.35, orange around 0.20, green around 0.25, red around 0.17, and a small purple segment around 0.03. In 2022, the bar is shown with lighter-tinted stacked segments corresponding to the same categories, with blue around 0.33, orange around 0.29, green around 0.22, and red around 0.16, and no visible purple segment; no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color/legend encoding, and the bars are ordered chronologically rather than sorted by magnitude.
